name: SnoCo Veteran's Weekend A 2022
information:
This competition is part of a series with [SnoCo Veteran's Weekend B 2022](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SnoCoVeteransWeekendB2022). Competitors are allowed to only compete in 1 competition. You can see more information on the [Competition Series](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SnoCoVeteransWeekendA2022#22394-competition-series) tab.

This is an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). If you are new to competing, please refer to the [Competitor Responsibilities](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SnoCoVeteransWeekendA2022#21405-please-read-competitor-responsibilities) tab.
